crossRefs.note: David recovered all that the Amalekites had taken, and David rescued his two wives.

people.name: Amalek
people.line: A nomadic people, descendants of Esau, enemies of Israel.

people.name: David
people.line: Anointed king of Israel, ancestor of Jesus Christ

translations.web: David recovered all that the Amalekites had taken, and David rescued his two wives.
translations.bsb: So David recovered everything the Amalekites had taken, including his two wives.
translations.kjv: And David recovered all that the Amalekites had carried away: and David rescued his two wives.
translations.asv: And David recovered all that the Amalekites had taken; and David rescued his two wives.
